raw_text: A deepfake video showing a top Bollywood actor appearing to endorse a PM candidate has been debunked by forensic analysts and the actor himself. The video, which went viral on social media platforms hours before a key election phase, showed telltale signs of AI manipulation including lip-sync mismatches, inconsistent facial lighting, and unnatural blinking patterns. The actor released a statement saying he has not endorsed any political candidate and urged voters not to be misled by manipulated content.
clean_text: Deepfake video of Bollywood actor endorsing PM candidate debunked by forensic analysts. Actor denied endorsement. Video showed lip-sync mismatches, inconsistent lighting, unnatural blinking.
